game_concept: A action puzzle set in Shadow Cave – Underground River, a black underground river: the shadow ranger must handle cave spiders while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Condition Builder: Choose the loop condition so the loop runs exactly the requested number of times.
theme: Shadow Cave – Underground River: a black underground river
core_gameplay_loop: In Underground River, repeat each round: Choose the loop condition so the loop runs exactly the requested number of times. Each round, a new arrows challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the loop_runs value and advance.
player_objective: Collect 340 points of arrows by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 340, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 4 – Control Flow: While Loops | Level 7 (applied tier): Condition Builder
assets_style: dark pixel-art cavern: torchlit stone, mossy rock, deep shadows, glowing crystals; flat Kenney-style sprites; echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Condition Builder' (Week 4 slot 14), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Underground River'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Shadow Cave
region.mood: echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how loop_runs changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against cave spiders in Underground River.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 340 within 48 seconds.
